rules.title: Tenant housing-rights Guide must accompany notice to quit or summary process
rules.requirement: A landlord must give tenants and lawful occupants the housing rights and resources Guide at the start and end of a tenancy, and again when legal steps to terminate the tenancy are taken, such as a Notice to Quit or Summary Process. The ordinance does not bar evictions otherwise allowed by law. Signed receipt is not required.

coverage.summary: Applies to tenants and lawful occupants, including tenants at will. No exemptions are stated in the passage.

rules.effective_date_note: The passage states no effective date.
citation_aliases: Cambridge tenant notification of housing rights ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance also requires that a landlord provide the Guide to tenants when legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken (ex. Notice to Quit or Summary Process).
rules.review_note: The passage does not name the city or the ordinance. Attribution to Cambridge and the chapter citation are inferred from the retrieval context. No Cambridge just-cause eviction rule appears in the passages, so this record covers only the tenant-rights notice delivered with a notice to quit.
rules.source_notes: Official FAQ-style guidance. The other passages describe California cities (Los Angeles, San Diego) or an unnamed city, not Cambridge.
